items.Title: Firmware Engineering Intern - Summer 2027
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Job Description

Are you interested in a career in Firmware development and contributing to a variety of embedded products? As a Firmware Engineer Intern, you'll participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle. You'll perform testing, create project and technical reports, and utilize and further develop tools for internal use.

We invite you to discover for yourself why a career with Resideo is the opportunity you've been looking for. Help create innovative technologies that make the world cleaner and more sustainable, more secure, connected, energy efficient, and productive. Come work alongside some of the world's most talented engineers!

JOB DUTIES:

  • Development of firmware with C/C++ targeting embedded systems and connected devices. 
  • Facilitate builds with source code control tools. 
  • Perform bench level testing with tools: debuggers, protocol analyzer, oscilloscope, multimeter, power analyzer. 
  • Plan and estimate development activities on an individual level and coordinate efforts with other team members. 
  • Report on task status in project team meetings. 
  • Follow details during all phases of SW design, development, integration, testing and release. 
  • Interface with other design engineers as required throughout the product development cycle and follow up on product support. 
  • Maintain code in repository and participate in peer code reviews. 

     

YOU MUST HAVE:

  • BS degree student currently enrolled in a technical discipline such as Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science. 
  • Completed coursework in C/C++ programming languages. 

  • Completed coursework in Objected Oriented Design. 

     

WE VALUE:

  • Proficient interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills. 
  • MS degree student in related technical discipline. 
  • Knowledge of 8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit microcontrollers. 
  • Knowledge of computer architecture and embedded systems. 
  • Experience in software development life cycles. 
  • Knowledge of bus protocols such as RS-232, I2C, SPI, and UART
  • Knowledge and/or experience with Python programming language. 
  • Knowledge of Agile/Scrum development process. 
  • Experience working with Jira, Confluence, Slack
  • Experience performing testing, troubleshooting, and debugging. 
  • The desire to collaborate with other Engineers and build connections with industry professionals in an interactive, team-based setting!

     

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:

  • Opportunity to collaborate with an exciting team with the reputation for building successful connected products. 
  • Opportunity to develop Firmware Engineer skills to contribute to the design of connected high volume consumer products.
